pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures.
   B. Say Names of Scriptures has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Names of Scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Places of Worship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of Worship.
   B. Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Places of Worship has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Places of Worship to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

6. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   D. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Simple postures? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Simple postures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Simple postures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Simple postures has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Simple postures.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   D. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings.
   B. Use The Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain The Enlightened Beings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Names of Scriptures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Simple postures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. B — Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

5. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

6. A — Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Apply the teaching of Simple postures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Enlightened Beings; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Simple postures; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of General Etiquette; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
